properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Maps: CORS Restrictions Configured
properties.description: Audits Azure Maps accounts to ensure CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) restrictions are configured. FedRAMP High requires information flow enforcement (AC-4). Azure Maps used in web applications must restrict CORS origins to authorized domains only, preventing unauthorized cross-origin access to map tile data and geospatial APIs.

metadata.description: Audit: Report Azure Maps accounts without CORS restrictions. Deny: Block deployment. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
